hook.name: Ctrl Immutable Launch Hook
hook.description: Immutable, non-proxy launchpad hook for Ctrl tokens paired with native ETH. Collects a fixed 1% ETH fee using swap return deltas for creator rewards, referrals, treasury and a graduation bounty. Empty swap hookData is accepted; attribution data is optional. Core LP fee is zero. Only the initial factory seed liquidity can be added, and its position is permanently locked. Graduation at 4.2 ETH net principal releases the bounty without migrating liquidity.
